user.title: Connect to GL.iNet router
user.description: Enter the router's address and admin password.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the router's admin password again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GL.iNet router
reconfigure.description: Update the router's address or admin password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the router.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The router at this address is a different device than the one originally configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll dynamic status (connectivity, clients, VPN/repeater state).
data_description.config_scan_interval: How often to re-read rarely-changing config (Wi-Fi, mode, LED, Tor). Edits made from Home Assistant still refresh immediately.
data_description.device_tracker_mode: Off removes all trackers. All clients creates one per client the router reports. Selected clients tracks only the clients you add with Add tracked client on the integration page.

block_client.name: Block client
block_client.description: Block or unblock a client device by MAC address.

device_id.name: Router
device_id.description: The GL.iNet router to act on.

blocked.name: Blocked
blocked.description: Whether the client should be blocked.

connect_repeater.name: Connect repeater
connect_repeater.description: Connect the router (in repeater mode) to an upstream Wi-Fi network.

device_id.name: Router
device_id.description: The GL.iNet router to act on.

ssid.name: SSID
ssid.description: The upstream network SSID to join.

password.name: Password
password.description: The upstream network password (leave blank for open networks).

identity.name: Identity
identity.description: Username for WPA-Enterprise (802.1X) networks. Leave blank otherwise.

bssid.name: BSSID
bssid.description: Target a specific access point by BSSID (from a scan_repeater result) when several nearby networks share the same SSID. Leave blank otherwise.

scan_repeater.name: Scan for repeater networks
scan_repeater.description: Scan for nearby Wi-Fi networks the router can join as a repeater. Returns the list of networks (SSID, BSSID, band, channel, signal, encryption).

device_id.name: Router
device_id.description: The GL.iNet router to act on.

set_mode.name: Set operating mode
set_mode.description: Switch the router's working mode. WARNING: disruptive — changing to Access Point can change the router's IP and briefly drop connectivity.

device_id.name: Router
device_id.description: The GL.iNet router to act on.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: The working mode to switch to.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true to proceed — guards against accidental mode changes.

set_wifi.name: Set Wi-Fi
set_wifi.description: Update a Wi-Fi interface's SSID, password, security, or enabled state.

device_id.name: Router
device_id.description: The GL.iNet router to act on.

iface_name.name: Interface name
iface_name.description: The Wi-Fi interface to modify (e.g. wifi2g, wifi5g, guest2g, guest5g).

encryption.name: Security
encryption.description: Wi-Fi security mode. none = open; psk2 = WPA2-PSK; sae = WPA3-SAE; psk-mixed = WPA2/WPA3; sae-mixed = WPA3/WPA2 transition.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the interface should be enabled.

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} is not a GL.iNet router known to Home Assistant.

entry_not_loaded.message: The GL.iNet router "{title}" is not loaded.

confirm_required.message: Refusing to change the operating mode without confirm: true (switching mode is disruptive and can change the router's IP).

wifi_iface_not_found.message: Wi-Fi interface {iface_name} was not found on the router.

user.title: Add tracked client
user.description: Choose a client the router has seen, or type its MAC address. Requires the Device trackers option to be set to Selected clients.

data_description.mac: Pick a client or enter a MAC address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
